title: Numerical Stability and Perturbation Behaviour in TF-IDF-Based Similarity Systems
description:
A self-contained implementation and analysis of a TF-IDF-based document similarity and ranking system, written to make the algebraic structure and perturbation behaviour of the pipeline explicit. The work treats ranking stability as a first-class object, characterising it through score-separation margin distributions, and isolates decision-level discontinuities introduced by deterministic tie-breaking rules.

It comprises a normative pure-Python reference implementation and a bit-identical optimised C++20 evaluator, whose equivalence is enforced by the test suite. Every published number is reproducible from a recorded pipeline digest.

The license field records the licence of the software. The prose, figures and generated reports are CC-BY-4.0; LICENSE.md sets out the split and REUSE.toml states it per file.
